wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a printed blank sheet with no ink in any of its ~40 ruled lines - an EMPTY schedule, zero rows. Cover line 1 reads a slashed-zero glyph in all three columns (LAST / THIS / CUMULATIVE), = 0 per the zero-glyph ruling; line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate, never itemized) likewise. Gen-1 Carr 5-5-PG prints NO schedule total, so the cover line is the only anchor (schedule_total: null). First report of the cycle - the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide at 0.

expenditures.detail: Two inked rows sum to 375.00 + 25.00 = 400.00, which equals cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS-REPORT cell (written '400' with superscript '00') and the CUMULATIVE cell (written '400.-', a trailing dash for no cents per 3(g)). LAST-REPORT column is a slashed-zero on every line, so this is the first report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide. Gen-1 form prints no schedule total (schedule_total: null); the filer nevertheless hand-wrote an unlabelled column total '400.-' one row below the last row - NOT transcribed as a row per core-brief 6. Cover line 4 balance cells are written in accounting brackets, '<400.->' in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns = -400.00.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 prints no schedule total (Gen-1). Rows-sum 400.00 == cover line 3 THIS (400.00) == cover line 3 CUMULATIVE (400.00). p2 has no ink and no printed total; nothing to gate.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 (200 dpi, 1690x2208): geometry ok, 36 bands, no vertical rules detected (the Gen-1 sheet is ruled horizontally only). Ink appears in band 1 (7.61%) and band 2 (10.40%) only - 2 data rows - plus the filer's hand-written column total in the band near 14.97%. 2 rows emitted. p2: 36 bands, zero inked.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 amount column, 600 dpi cell crops: first-row box renders '375' with superscript '00'; last-row (row 2) box renders '25.' with superscript '00'; the control box one row-pitch below renders NO digits (only the printed rule and the tail of the filer's underline stroke drawn above his hand total).
gates.balance_chain: 0 (contributions over $50) + 0 ($50-or-less aggregate) - 400.00 (expenditures) = -400.00 = cover line 4 CUMULATIVE '<400.->'. Closes exactly. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk to chain against.

escalation_note: p3 rows 1-2 re-read as two 600 dpi half-width crops (payee/date half and purpose/amount half); amount column additionally re-read as three 600 dpi single-cell crops for the geometry proof.
notes: Generation 1 (Carr Printing 5-5-PG; cover cites Utah Code 17-16-6.5). index.csv says candidate 'David Whitehead', office 'Treasurer', year 2010 - the form agrees: 'Full Name of Candidate DAVID WHITEHEAD', 'Name of Office TREASURER', 'Office District Washington County', 'Political Party Republican', signed 4/7/10, clerk RECEIVED stamp APR 7 2010. Candidate home address, ZIP and both phone numbers printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time per core-brief 5. p2 (Form A) exists and is entirely blank - an honest zero, not a gap.

the payee cell overflows past the column rule into the Purpose column and is separated from the purpose by a dash: 'Washington County Republican Party - Table for Convention'; cents written as superscript '00'. Date cell verbatim '4/5/10'.
